jobs.title: Corporate Finance Manager
jobs.description:
What the Role Is

We are looking for a Corporate Finance Manager to join our growing Finance team! In this role, you will partner with the Director of Corporate Finance, VP of Finance on consolidations, opex, balance sheet and cash flow forecasting, internal business reviews, external board reporting, and ad hoc analyses.

Reporting to the Director of Corporate Finance, you will contribute to financial reporting delivered to executive leadership and other stakeholders including our board and investors. This role requires a high degree of independent ownership, rigorous accuracy, and proactive communication — and a hands-on appetite for using AI to automate and improve how we work. The role operates with meaningful autonomy: you frame problems yourself, build the mechanisms that keep budgets and forecasts honest, and bring recommendations rather than questions, often where no template or precedent exists yet. We care more about how you think and operate than where you have worked. Strong candidates come from FP&A and corporate finance, and also from finance business partnering, investment banking, private equity, consulting, strategic finance or accounting, as long as you are fluent in financial statements and can turn numbers into a story.

Who You Are

- Work experience: 5+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, finance business partnering, strategic finance, investment banking, private equity, consulting, accounting or a related analytical role, with Manager-level ownership or the equivalent scope, and a strong understanding of financial statements. You have owned a recurring deliverable for a senior audience end to end across multiple cycles (an exec or board package, a monthly reporting pack, a client or deal model), and you have built or materially rebuilt a process or model from the ground up rather than only operated one.

- Key skills and tools: Fluency in financial statements and how they connect, including balance sheet and cash flow mechanics. Advanced analytical and modeling skills, including building models from the ground up and working with large, detailed datasets. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets and strong slide-building skills.

- Strong written and oral communication skills: You distill complex analyses into clear, concise insights and recommendations for executive and board audiences, tell the story behind the numbers, and build effective working relationships with leaders outside Finance.

- Demonstrated independent ownership and problem-solving: Able to take an ambiguous problem, frame it, set priorities, and drive the work forward in the absence of templates or clear precedent. You make the routine calls yourself and bring your manager a proposal with only the decisions that need them. Does not require hand-holding on day-to-day execution.

- Exceptional accuracy and quality control: Owns and takes pride in their work. Builds checks into models and decks, self-reviews before sending work up, and treats precision as a core professional value. Catches errors before they become someone else's problem. When you hand something over as ready, it is ready: tied to source, checked against house style, and reviewed by you first, so your manager's pass is the last check rather than the first. When you fix an issue, you fix it at the source so it does not return, and your fixes do not introduce new ones.

- Proactive communication and workplan execution: Surfaces risks early, keeps stakeholders informed without being prompted, manages their own timelines, and delivers on commitments without needing to be chased. When a date will slip, your manager hears it from you before the deadline.

- Hands-on curiosity and demonstrated use of AI tools in finance workflows: Has concrete, specific examples of using AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to automate reporting, accelerate analysis, improve modeling, or scale deliverables. Actively looks for new places to apply AI and is energized by the pace of change. You are accountable for every number and sentence in your deliverable regardless of which tool produced it, and you never hand over AI output you have not read and verified.

- Moves at pace and learns fast: Comfortable taking on work you have not done before and learning new tools, systems and parts of the business quickly. Scrappy, curious, and a tinkerer by nature. Delivers under pressure when conditions change.

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or another quantitative field.

- You're genuinely excited about what AI can do - not just as a concept, but as something you want to get your hands on. At Babylist, every team uses AI daily, and we're looking for people who lean in.

- Nice to have: Planning systems (Netsuite Planning and Budgeting, Oracle Hyperion, Anaplan, Adaptive), SQL or BI tools; experience improving or automating reporting and planning processes; familiarity with e-commerce, marketplace or retail business models; experience at both public and high-growth private companies; MBA or CPA.

How You Will Make An Impact

- Own the execution of our monthly, quarterly, and annual FP&A processes, including the forecast calendar, key milestones, and long-term financial modeling, driving these cycles independently end to end.

- Develop deep understanding of the Babylist business model and key levers in our business — build genuine business curiosity and fluency in how we make money, what drives growth and margin, and where the risks live. Use that understanding to deliver insights and commentary that connect the numbers to the underlying business, not just describe variances.

- Contribute to executive and board of directors presentation materials on business performance and strategic business decisions — preparing analyses, drafting slides, and owning the accuracy of underlying data.

- Prepare consolidated income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow models. Analyze actual to expected performance with rigorous variance commentary grounded in data, not guesswork.

- Ensure that our short, medium, and long range financial plans are built and delivered as part of a rigorous and collaborative process.

- Own and improve the total company opex budgeting process (who requests, who approves, who loads, how it is documented) at the GL and department level, in partnership with department heads, Accounting, and the People team on headcount planning. Build the inspection mechanisms (budget log, approval thresholds, plan-to-actual GL mapping) that hold budget owners accountable to plan.

- Develop and maintain financial models, reports, and analysis to support key business decisions and strategic initiatives

- Perform ad-hoc reporting and analysis as required, proactively surfacing insights and risks to the Director of Corporate Finance, VP of Finance, CFO, and business partners.

- Identify and implement AI-enabled automation across FP&A workflows — actively experiment with AI tools to reduce manual effort on reporting, modeling, variance analysis, and deck production, and share learnings across the Finance team. Improve and scale by developing repeatable processes, including standardizing and automating reports and implementing enhancements to planning and forecast systems.

- Take pride in your work and operate with a strong accuracy and quality control mindset — building review checkpoints, reconciliations, and self-QC habits into every deliverable before it leaves your desk.

Our interview Process

A recruiter screen, a 30-minute conversation with the hiring manager, a three-hour live working session on a realistic finance case (recorded, no AI, no preparation required), then a half-day final round with the Finance team. The live session replaces a take-home, so the total time you spend is lower and you see the work before you decide.

About Compensation

We use a market-based approach to compensation. The starting salary range for this role is:

C$147,000 to C$176,375

Your starting salary will be based on your location, experience, and qualifications, with increases over time tied to performance, role growth, and internal pay equity.

Who We Are

Babylist is the leading platform for expecting and new families. More than 10 million people shop with Babylist every year, making it the go-to destination for seamless purchasing, guidance, and expert recommendations. As a modern, AI-forward tech company, Babylist has expanded from a universal registry into a full ecosystem — the Babylist Shop, Babylist Health, Babylist Money, NYC and LA showrooms, branded content, and more — generating $750M in revenue in 2025. Building the generational brand in baby, Babylist is reshaping the $235B kids and baby market and helping parents feel confident, connected, and cared for at every step.

Our Ways of Working

Babylist is remote-first with team members across the U.S. and Canada who move fast, think smart, and use AI as part of how they work every day — not as an experiment, as an expectation. We come together twice a year to build the relationships behind the work, and we hire people who are genuinely excited about what's possible and prove it through how they show up.

Why You Will Love Working At Babylist

Our Culture

- We work with focus and intention, then step away to recharge

- We believe in exceptional management, and we invest in the tools and the time to connect with colleagues

- We build products that positively impact millions of people's lives

- AI is part of how we work, not a side experiment. You'll have leading tools like Claude and ChatGPT from day one, with no waiting on access, so the busywork gets handled and your judgment goes where it counts

Growth & Development

- Competitive pay and meaningful opportunities for career advancement

- We believe technology and data can solve hard problems

- We're committed to career progression and performance-based advancement

Benefits

- Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance

- Retirement savings plan with company matching and flexible spending accounts

- Generous paid parental leave and PTO

- Winter Wonder Week: the whole company takes a paid week off at the end of the year, whether or not you celebrate anything, so everyone's out at once and comes back refreshed

- Perks for physical, mental, and emotional health, parenting, childcare, and financial planning

How We Review Applications  We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.

jobs.title: Finance Manager, E-Commerce
jobs.description:
What the Role Is

We are looking for an E-commerce Finance Manager to join our team. As Finance Manager for our E-commerce business, you'll own financial visibility, efficiency, and performance across the Babylist Shop — topline through gross margin. You'll partner with Merchandising, Planning, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Data, and work directly with the Director of Strategic Finance to turn analysis into decisions on pricing, promotions, and investment. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role on a lean team: you'll set the approach, build the models and processes, and be front and center with company executives. If you've owned a full P&L picture and take pride in delivering clean, decision-ready work, you'll thrive here.

Who You Are

- Deep ecommerce finance fluency — you know the metrics and mechanics cold (AOV, gross-to-net, unit economics, and gross margin vs. contribution margin), ideally from a high-volume ecommerce or consumer-tech business

- Advanced financial modeling skills — expert in Excel / Google Sheets, scenario analysis, and managing large datasets to a clean, reliable answer

- Strong independent ownership and problem-solving — you can take an ambiguous problem, define the approach, and drive to a clear answer without day-to-day direction

- Executive- and board-ready communication — you present financial insights clearly and directly to senior leaders, connecting the numbers to what's happening in the business, including strong data visualization

- A high bar for accuracy and quality control — you build checks into your models and decks, reconcile outputs, and catch errors before they reach stakeholders

- You naturally reach for AI in your work — at Babylist, every team uses AI daily. You're already using it to move faster and improve your output, and you stay curious about what's coming next.

- Prior experience owning pricing and promotional decisions, with a focus on ROI and financial impact

- You have hands-on experience using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) in finance workflows, with clear examples of automating reporting, accelerating analysis, or improving how you model

- Experience with financial planning systems such as NetSuite Planning & Budgeting, Oracle Hyperion, or similar

- 5–8 years of experience, ideally in an FP&A role at a high-growth consumer technology or ecommerce company, with 1–2 years at the Manager level preferred or equivalent ownership and scope in a lean, cross-functional finance environment

- A bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field; MBA a plus

How You Will Make An Impact

- Proactively surface risks, opportunities, and value-added recommendations from both an operational and strategic viewpoint

- Own the monthly financial business review for the Ecommerce business, delivering insights on sales, margins, and trends

- Own Ecommerce forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis in partnership with Merchandising, Planning, and Accounting

- Lead pricing and promotional analysis, including ROI evaluation and optimization

- Analyze Co-Op, DDA, and rebate programs to assess financial impact and track accruals

- Deliver SKU- and department-level reporting from revenue through margin

- Ensure the data integrity of key ecommerce metrics in partnership with Data and Engineering

- Build financial reporting that leadership relies on — dynamic dashboards, KPI and operational reporting, business analyses, and clear executive-level explanations of variances

- Take ownership of establishing and managing new financial processes and reporting frameworks to close gaps and improve operational transparency

- Leverage financial systems to give business leaders visibility to track against financial targets

- Contribute to monthly and quarterly board presentations, the annual planning process, and long-range planning (5-Year Plan)

- Identify and implement AI-enabled improvements across ecommerce FP&A workflows, reducing manual effort and increasing speed and consistency

Why This Role

- You own ecommerce finance — topline through margin — for one of the largest parts of the business, not a slice of it

- Your analysis reaches executives and the board and directly shapes decisions on pricing, promotions, and investment

- High autonomy on a lean team: you define the approach in ambiguity rather than inheriting a fully built playbook

- Babylist is pushing the frontier of AI, and you'll have a real mandate to reshape how FP&A works, not just experiment at the edges

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Data Analytics
jobs.description:
What the Role Is

As the Senior Manager of Data Analytics for Ecommerce, Health & Supply Chain, this role will be responsible for partnering with Health, Merchandising, Inventory Management, and Fulfillment teams. You will influence the company’s strategy and help the company grow through advanced business analytics that raise data fluency and sharpen how decisions are made. The successful leader must be ready to roll up their sleeves and dive into the data, systems, and models, while working collaboratively with the team ensuring you are able to effectively partner across the organization. This highly visible role will interact with the executive team as a thought partner to bring new insights and recommendations to the table.

Who You Are

- Deep eCommerce or retail analytics experience - fluent in the core KPIs for inventory, order economics, pricing, and fulfillment/supply chain cost and efficiency (AOV, unit economics, instock rates, meat beat scores, fulfillment CPUs), and you apply proven industry practice rather than rebuilding it from scratch

- Proven at balancing people management with hands-on IC work - you can point to analysis you've owned yourself while leading a team, not just work you've coordinated

- Experienced managing experienced analysts - you bring structure and clear prioritization to a team that already executes well, so they're always on the highest-impact work

- Confident partnering with VP+ stakeholders - you've built real relationships with senior business leaders and shape priorities with them proactively, front and center with executives

- Hands-on with AI-native analytics - you've built or are genuinely curious about self-serve analytics infrastructure (semantic layers, context layers, AI-connected reporting), not just traditional dashboards

- Engaged in what we're building - you ask why before how, challenge assumptions, and contribute to direction instead of delivering dashboards in isolation

- Prioritizes progress over perfection - you scale rigor to what's at stake and ship a strong, decision-ready answer on time rather than over-polishing

- 8+ years of experience, ideally with experience in a Data role in a high growth consumer technology or e-commerce company; 5+ years of experience at a manager level

- You naturally reach for AI in your work - at Babylist, every team uses AI daily. You're already using it to move faster and improve your output, and you stay curious about what's coming next.

- Strong sense of ownership, intellectual curiosity and an ability to think creatively and critically and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities

- High attention to detail but an equally important ability to see the big picture and evaluate analyses with strategic business context

- Extensive experience in data analytics, big data technologies, and statistical modeling to drive business insights.

- Strong knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and data strategy principles.

- Lead and develop 5 experienced analysts and data scientists - prioritization, coaching, quarterly goal-setting, and clean handoffs with stakeholders

- Own a meaningful book of actionable analysis yourself across eCommerce, supply chain, and health - you stay close to the data, not managing from a distance

- Partner directly with senior leaders in each area, with regular exposure to the executive team

- Advance our AI-native analytics roadmap, including self-serve tools that connect business teams directly to our data
